PolicyVisor (pVisor)

Review an agent’s file changes
before they land.

Run Claude Code, Codex or any script in a staged workspace.
Accept the paths you want; drop the rest.

$ pvisor spawn --safe -- claude
$ pvisor review last
$ pvisor apply last --path src
